name: Teen Leadership Training (TLT)
org: City of Mesa Parks, Recreation and Community Facilities
what_you_do: Be a junior staff volunteer at Mesa summer camps: help with group games, crafts and swimming trips. Builds job skills.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 17. You must be 13 by the start of the program. Space is limited.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Program fee is $32 for Mesa residents and $38 for non-residents.
duration: Summer camp season. Mandatory training dates differ by camp.
deadline_text: Starts when Mesa summer camp registration opens. 2027 dates not posted in the FAQ.
how_to_apply: Sign up for a camp in ActiveNet. Then get a form and an interview link. Then do the interview and the training you must take. Adaptive camps (Camp Fiesta, Wiggles & Giggles) need a form and interview before you sign up.
notes: The City of Mesa website blocked a normal page visit, so the facts come from the 2026 FAQ PDF. Check the Mesa summer registration dates. Contact: PRCFVolunteers@mesaaz.gov or 480-644-4345 (from a search listing, not the PDF).
